entities.name: Abel Tasman
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dutch navigator (1603–1659) who was the first known European to reach Tasmania, New Zealand, Tonga, and Fiji during his 1642–1643 voyage for the Dutch East India Company. Though he never set foot on mainland Australia, his voyages proved it was not connected to a hypothetical southern continent.
